title: Las cuerdas: la voz de Marta, de lejos a cerca
description: docs/quests/marta.md § Final boss, docs/audio.md § La Voz. Marta's recording heard far off in Las cuerdas on the mazes' clock (low, muffled, mostly echo), nearer with each quality beaten, then whole and held to the fight's clock against La Voz. The box on the right reads what src/voz-song.ts is playing. Needs --chrome (Playwright's Chromium cannot decode AAC).

steps.caption: First maze, nothing beaten: her song far off, low and muffled
Two qualities beaten: nearer, louder and clearer
The three beaten, at the centre: as near as it gets before her fight
Her fight: the far song gone, the recording whole, where the fight's clock is (file second = song second + 1.03)
